blocks.text: With Christmas just around the corner, LOEWE has unveiled a special holiday capsule collection inspired by Tim Burton's beloved Disney animated classic, The Nightmare Before Christmas. The new pieces bring the film's characters and fantastical scenes to life through leather marquetry, embroidery, printing, and enamelwork, transforming the movie's eerie yet heartwarming premise into wearable surrealism.
(Swipe left or right to view more images)
· The Nightmare Before Christmas ·
The Nightmare Before Christmas is a stop-motion animated film released in 1993, created and produced by American animator and director Tim Burton and directed by American filmmaker Henry Selick.

The story follows Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King and leader of Halloween Town, who grows weary of the annual horror festivities. After stumbling into Christmas Town, he is enchanted by the joyful Christmas atmosphere and resolves to take over and improve the holiday in his own way. He kidnaps Santa Claus, mobilizes the residents of Halloween Town to craft terrifying gifts, and personally impersonates Santa to deliver them to the real world, ultimately causing widespread panic. After his plan fails, Jack comes to his senses, rescues Santa from the villain, and restores Christmas to its original glory, while also forging a romantic connection with the rag doll Sally.

The film's characters and sets were brought to life using articulated puppets and meticulously constructed miniature sets, all crafted by hand. The characters began as sketches before being transformed frame by frame into three-dimensional forms. The new LOEWE holiday collection is rooted in this shared ethos of craftsmanship; during its creation, the film's archives were opened to the brand for the first time, giving LOEWE access to the original design sketches and puppet models behind characters such as Jack, Sally, and Zero, as well as the film's scenes.
· Animated Scenes ·

This group of bags vividly recreates scenes from the animated film on the body of each piece—you can see the Puzzle Edge bag featuring the night sky and full moon from the movie poster, with the silhouette of protagonist Jack looking especially tall and striking, while velvet tufting and embroidery details add refinement and dimension. Another Flamenco clutch depicts the snow-covered town from the film entirely in bead embroidery, brimming with festive Christmas cheer.
· Animated Characters ·

Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King and leader of Halloween Town, has a tall, skeletal frame and typically wears a pinstriped black suit with a bat-shaped bow tie. For this collection, LOEWE adorns the Hammock bag and Amazona handbag with Jack via embroidery and printing, in white and charcoal tones that exude a playful, mischievous spirit.
(Swipe left or right to view more images)

Jack's loyal pet is Zero, a ghostly dog with a glowing pumpkin for a nose. The most distinctive design is a Scarf bag, where the knot on one side is transformed into Zero's head, accented with leather marquetry eyes and a felt nose, while the flowing knotted ears add a lively, adorable touch.
(Swipe left or right to view more images)

The Mayor of Halloween Town may hold the title, but he wields virtually no real power and relies on the spiritual leader Jack for everything. With a cone-shaped body and head, a tall top hat, and a golden sash reading "Mayor" across his chest, he is a memorable figure. This collection introduces a Puzzle Fold tote whose leather panels at the top corners transform into the Mayor's likeness—especially whimsical when folded, evoking childhood paper-folding play.

This group of bags is crafted with leather patchwork, where black hand-stitching highlights a distinctive patched effect inspired by the film's heroine, Sally. Sally is a patchwork rag doll sewn together by the mad scientist Dr. Finkelstein, stuffed with autumn leaves and assembled from various scraps of fabric, with limbs that can be detached and reattached at will.
(Swipe left or right to view more images)

This group of bags centers on the residents and quirky toys from The Nightmare Before Christmas. You'll find a Puzzle Fold tote embellished with an embroidery of the upright-walking werewolf, and a Flamenco clutch decorated with leather scales and feather elements inspired by the film's bizarre resident, the Harlequin Demon.
(Swipe left or right to view more images)

The most whimsical of all are these two novelty bags: one takes the film's terrifying toy duck as its design motif, while the other is themed around the resident Harlequin Demon. Their eccentric shapes are perfect for fantasy-themed parties and guaranteed to turn heads.
(Swipe left or right to view more images)
· Small Leather Goods and Accessories ·

The collection also offers a wide array of accessories, including small leather goods, bag charms, and storage boxes, all vividly recreating the characters from The Nightmare Before Christmas. As a Christmas surprise gift for friends, they carry a delightful sense of childlike wonder~
